display_name: Mars surface suit, sealed (out on the dig: CH01-CH03, CH06)
_canon_basis: CH01 suit knees caked in dust, visor HUD pings vitals; CH02 visor tinted against the morning glare; CH03 breath fogging the visor, suit audio feed, external mic. Mars air is ~0.6% of Earth's pressure, so outdoors the helmet is always sealed.
_design_basis: 2026-11-14 author direction: a believable 2050 descendant of the SpaceX Polaris Dawn EVA suit and NASA/Axiom AxEMU. Woven outer fabric is accurate; adds the hard upper torso, rear-entry hatch, bearing rings, neck ring, backpack and dust-shedding lower legs a Mars surface suit needs.

reference_images.label: Approved Mars surface suit (shown on Galen)
reference_images.instruction: match the suit design exactly: the HARD-SHELL helmet with its clear face visor (never a bubble dome), raised gold sun visor, neck ring, chest unit, harness, fabric, orange piping and insignia layout; the face, name tape and role-tab color come from the wearer's own references, not from this image

_reference_note: Approved 2026-11-14. Its chest display text (SOL 0473, EXT TEMP) is generated and not canon; the book's Mars scenes are Mission Days 38-46.
_helmet_note: Helmet locked 2026-11-14 to the approved suit reference (mars-surface-suit.png): a hard shell with a face visor, not a bubble dome. The bubble domes in the first cast trench shot are not canon.
